capture_method: Full-page JPEG screenshot from the Codex in-app browser of a local HTML view generated directly from source records. Images were not generated or edited after capture.
limitations: Recorded live experiment covers EVE-NG Professional 7.2.0-4 and IOSv 15.9(3)M6 only.
No convergence time, packet loss during transition, throughput, jitter, application availability or SLA measured.
The 45-second settling wait is not measured convergence.
The local 65-test run includes replay of recorded IOS data; it is not a new live test or a GitHub Actions run.

privacy_review.visual_review: All four JPEGs inspected; all content readable with no clipping. Only synthetic router names and benchmarking addresses appear.
privacy_review.source_scope: Public repository evidence files at the pinned commit; no private harness files or infrastructure UI used.

images.title: Recorded verification across three phases
images.caption_en: Recorded EVE-NG/IOSv validation: 20/20 baseline checks, 18/20 during a deliberate primary-link fault, and 20/20 after recovery. Both lost OSPF adjacencies are reported while all 12 loopback probes pass during the fault.
images.proves: All 60 check outcomes from three recorded reports; fault detection remains visible despite successful forwarding.
images.rendering: All checks aligned by router and check label; status strings preserved; counts calculated directly from recorded checks.

images.title: Recorded primary and backup routing
images.caption_en: Recorded IOSv route snapshots show the branch switching to the backup next hop during the primary-link fault and returning to the primary next hop after restoration. Each settled snapshot includes a successful five-packet probe; convergence time and loss during switchover were not measured.
images.proves: Observed primary to backup to primary next-hop changes for the headquarters loopback in the synthetic lab.
images.rendering: Complete route stdout for each phase plus the final three lines of each ping stdout; CRLF normalized for browser display; source fields otherwise unchanged.

images.title: Recorded configuration repeatability
images.caption_en: Recorded Ansible configuration recaps show changed=5 on the first apply and changed=0 on the second apply for all four IOSv routers, with no unreachable hosts or failed tasks.
images.proves: Idempotence of the corrected configuration playbook for this tested scenario.
images.rendering: Complete published recap text with trailing newline removed for display.
